// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const JELLY_PLUGIN_ID = "io.molis.work.jelly";

export declare const JELLY_PROJECT_PLUGIN_ID = "jelly";

export interface JellyCategory {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    color: string;
    sort_index: number;
    revision: number;
}

export interface JellyItem extends JellySchedule {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    kind: "task" | "event";
    category_id: string;
    notes: string;
    completed_at: string | null;
    revision: number;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface JellyNote {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    body: string;
    day: string | null;
    revision: number;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface JellyOccurrence extends JellyItem {
    series_id: string | null;
    original_date: string | null;
}

export type JellyOccurrencePatch = Partial<Pick<JellyItem, "title" | "kind" | "category_id" | "notes" | "start_date" | "end_date" | "start_time" | "end_time" | "reminder_minutes">>;

export type JellyRestoreReceipt = JellyRestoreRows & {
    modified?: {
        kind: "item" | "series";
        id: string;
        digest: string;
    }[];
};

export type JellyRestoreRows = {
    categories?: JellyCategory[];
    items?: JellyItem[];
    series?: JellySeries[];
    notes?: JellyNote[];
};

export interface JellySchedule {
    start_date: string;
    end_date: string;
    start_time: number | null;
    end_time: number | null;
    time_zone: string;
    reminder_minutes: number | null;
}

export interface JellySeries extends Omit<JellyItem, "completed_at"> {
    weekdays: number[];
    until: string | null;
    exceptions: Record<string, {
        deleted?: true;
        patch?: JellyOccurrencePatch;
    }>;
    completions: Record<string, string>;
}
